front: Name four reasons to avoid a foundation model.
back: A strong simple baseline, rich covariates, tight latency or cost, and explainability, regulation or data-policy limits.
forecasts per day × seconds per forecast / 3600 × price per hour.

front: Where do foundation models fit well?
back: Cold start, many short or low-value series, quick prototypes, and as members of an ensemble.

front: What did M5 show about model types?
back: LightGBM with careful features and covariates won the retail data, ahead of deep learning approaches.

front: What does a written model decision rule include?
back: Decision and cost of error, baseline ladder, same backtest, cost/latency/policy, pinned version, monitoring, fallback, review date.
